scientific_integrity: Proof gives all-integer-size claims; finite computational checks are supplementary and are not substituted for the analytic proof. No independent evaluation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to uniform labelled Cayley trees and expected values conditioned on the degree of a fixed vertex; it does not assert distributional stochastic ordering or extensions to other random-tree models. Historical degree-marked generating functions not located may encode equivalent results.
title: Degree two uniquely maximizes conditional expected Wiener index in uniform Cayley trees
